text: ICICI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 read with para A of Schedule III and Regulation 46(2) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
nse_summary: ICICI Bank Limited has disclosed the schedule of investor meets under SEBI Listing Regulations. The bank will refer to publicly available documents during these interactions. The scheduled events include the CITIC CLSA India Forum 2026 on November 16, 2026, and the Investec Kotak Offshore Client Group Meeting on November 16, 2026, both held in person. On November 17, 2026, the bank will attend the JM Financial India Xchange 2026 and the Institutional Investor Meet, both in person. The Avendus Spark INDX Conference 2026 is scheduled for November 18, 2026, in person. The Morgan Stanley Twenty-Fifth Annual Asia Pacific Summit will take place from November 18 to 19, 2026, in person. Finally, the CLSA Financials Trip is set for November 19, 2026, in person.

ICICI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board at its meeting held today, inter alia, approved the filing of an application with RBI seeking its approval for the continuation of Mr. Pradeep Kumar Sinha as a Non-executive Part-time Chairperson of the Bank for a further period from July 1, 2027 till February 16, 2029 which is within his tenure as Independent Director approved by the Board and shareholders. This information is being filed in continuation of the disclosures filed by the Bank on February 17, 2024 and May 24, 2024.
